faqs.q: Is local SEO different from regular SEO in Italy?
faqs.a: Yes. Local SEO targets the map pack, local-intent keywords, and review signals. A generic national strategy will not win you customers searching with local intent in Milan or Rome. The tactics overlap, but the priorities are completely different.

faqs.q: Can I do SEO for my Italian business myself?
faqs.a: You can handle the basics: claim your profile, ask for reviews, keep your hours accurate. The technical work, Italian keyword research, and authority building are where a specialist earns their keep. Most owners run out of hours before they run out of tasks.

faqs.q: Why is my competitor outranking me in Italy?
faqs.a: Usually stronger reviews, better Italian-language relevance, or more links from Italian sites. I check all three in the audit and tell you which one is actually costing you the ranking, so we fix the right thing first.

faqs.q: Do I need a Google Business Profile in Italy?
faqs.a: Absolutely. It is free and often the first thing customers see. In Italy's relationship-driven market, a complete profile with genuine reviews beats a beautiful website with an empty profile every time.
